statement: Specified compatible local multiplicative Kummer classes over a number field come from one unique global completed class exactly when, at every modulus, they form a restricted-product element and annihilate all dual cyclic characters under the sum of local invariants. Finite localization fibres give compatible global choices without surjective transition maps. For a new rational puncture a on the three-punctured line, the missing canonical-value reciprocity tests form the split Brauer residue summand H1(k,Z/n), represented by kappa(t-a) cup chi.
where_proved: sections/D_canonical_lifting_extension.tex, D.27; actual-image Poitou-Tate exactness, finite localization fibres and inverse-limit compactness, D.26 uniqueness, and the explicit regular-curve residue sequence; exact symbol check code/D_canonical_symbol_certificate.py with output audit/D_canonical_symbol_certificate.json
depends_on: D.26; Milne2006 Arithmetic Duality Theorems I Lemmas4.8-4.9 and Theorem4.10(a)-(b); Colliot-Thelene-Skorobogatov2019 Section1.4.1 equation(1.17), Theorem1.4.10 and Proposition3.6.1; D.23-D.24 for the central-lift interpretation

doubtful_reading: No new manuscript reading. This proves the precise conditional arithmetic matching criterion; it does not assert its hypotheses for every section.
notes: Root independently opened Milne and CTS and approved the argument before integration. The exact kernel is the actual global H1 image, not only its closure. Finite-level localization need not be injective, and inverse-system transitions need not be surjective. New equality places x_v=a require a chosen new tangent; old cusps use their existing tangent; real signs are not silently chosen. The residue arrow is the cohomological residue, negative Witt by CTS Theorem1.4.10. The example x_v=3 except x_3=4 has the nonzero symbol (2,3)_3 and is explicitly not claimed to arise from a section. No D1-D4 resolution or cofinite-integrality conclusion is claimed. The exact certificate computes (2,3)_3=-1 and invariant sum1/2; all other places vanish identically because the first symbol entry is1. Local differences are explicitly H1 classes with Tate-module coefficients.
